name: wagerwake
description: Dice & Cards — free and USDC-wagered multiplayer dice/card games on Solana

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wagerwake/app && npm run build -w @wagerwake/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wagerwake/shared && npm run typecheck -w @wagerwake/server && npm run typecheck -w @wagerwake/app
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wagerwake/shared && npm run test -w @wagerwake/server
